messages:
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@greenleaf.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: control-plane attestation & evidence for SOC 2/SIG

Hi Jasmine,

We're starting our compliance window and the auditor team asked for a succinct attestation of Redwood's "control plane" boundaries and how it is isolated between Hosted/Dedicated/Private modes.

Specifically they requested:
- A short narrative describing control-plane components and the data paths that cross trust boundaries (what's metadata-only vs customer data).
- Network diagram(s) showing Dedicated vs Private topology and where the control plane services live.
- Evidence index (logs, config snippets, KMS ARNs, SOC2 control mapping) we can reference in the audit binder.

Can Redwood provide an attestation playbook and evidence pack by EOW next week (Dec 21)? We can accept an initial package and follow-ups.

Thanks,
Audrey Chen
Senior Security Program Manager
Greenleaf AI

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: control-plane attestation & evidence for SOC 2/SIG

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We're happy to provide a playbook and evidence index.

Plan:
1) I'll own the narrative and attestation statement (deliverable: controlplane-attestation-playbook.pdf).
2) Kimberly will produce network diagrams and a short topology narrative for Dedicated vs Private (deliverable: controlplane-network-diagram.svg + notes).
3) Rishi will pull a scoped evidence index (logs/config/ARNS) and short exportable artifacts for the binder (deliverable: evidence-index.csv + snippets).

Questions / constraints:
- For Private (VPC/on‑prem), do you want both the VPC peering example and an air‑gapped on‑prem example? We can include both but will call out which evidence applies to onsite deployments.
- We will mark customer-data-touching paths vs metadata-only paths in the diagrams and narrative.

Target: initial package to you by 2026-12-21 17:00 PT. If that works I'll start collating and Kimberly/Rishi will add their pieces.

Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-18T11:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: control-plane attestation & evidence for SOC 2/SIG

Jasmine — draft attachments and notes attached.

Attached (draft):
- controlplane-network-diagram.svg (two-page: Dedicated pool topology + Private VPC/on‑prem examples)
- diagram-notes.txt (bullets for each component)

High-level points I'll include in the narrative:
- Control plane services (orchestration, model catalog, routing) run in a separate management VPC; management VPC peering only exists for Dedicated if customer approves (no default cross-tenant routing).
- Customer data (inference payloads) remains on serving plane; only telemetry/metrics/placement metadata flows to control plane.
- KMS boundary: customer plaintext keys never exported; we store only key identifiers (ARNs) when a customer opts in to bring-your-own-key for Private deployments.
- Network controls: ACLs, route tables, restricted egress gateways, and per-customer NATting for Dedicated pools to prevent tenant-to-tenant traffic.

I'll attach the diagram stubs here. Rishi — can you add the specific log exports and config snippet locations for the evidence-index?

Kimberly Park
Principal Security Architect
Redwood Inference

- controlplane-network-diagram.svg — annotated topology for Hosted / Dedicated / Private; control-plane vs serving-plane boundaries; data flow classification (metadata vs customer payload).
- evidence-index.csv — index of artifacts included or available on request (log exports, KMS ARNs, config snippets, PKI cert references).

Notes / next steps:
- Private on‑prem customers: some artifacts are config templates (not global exports) — we've marked those rows in the CSV. If you need downloadable bundles for the on‑prem case we'll prepare a separate package.
- If auditors want a live walk-through, Kimberly can present the topology and I can run through the evidence-index. Proposed slot: 2026-12-28 10:00 PT.

Attachments included in this email (stubs): controlplane-attestation-playbook.pdf (PDF), controlplane-network-diagram.svg (SVG), evidence-index.csv (CSV).

Thanks — let us know any clarifying questions and whether you want the live session.

Best,
